changes: Classic v11 now has a 28x24-point display-options chevron at the lower-right caption row. Wide windows align it to the available far edge; narrow windows retain access through the ribbon scroller. Its 280-point popup body has two contiguous 40-point rows with selected markers and uses existing AlwaysShowToolbar/AutoHideToolbar actions and persistence. Hover/open feedback and accessibility labels follow other Classic dropdowns.

gui.scope: Full UI suite passes. New light 1x/dark 2x and narrow checks cover trigger/row bounds, selected state, Escape without changing preferences, persisted modes, hide/reveal and no document/history changes under repeated layout. Existing coalesced press/release mapping, open-popup reveal and Studio isolation tests pass.

gpu.scope: Eight raw light/dark scenes: desktop popup with always-show selected, auto-hide selected, hidden ribbon and a horizontally scrolled compact popup.

checks: Formatting, whitespace and source file length checks passed.
limits: The reference shows the chevron and existing View choices; the direct popup styling follows shared Classic conventions rather than a supplied close-up of that popup. Native Windows menu behavior and full reference fidelity remain partial. No new document operation or performance claim.
